notes: OpenCode 2.x through the service API (#2109 P5b-1). One turn, 20s idle, a second turn on the same ses_… session. Recorded with the daemon's default ready TTL, as V1 was: a shortened TTL reaps an idle service-hosted root by design (pid_manager idlesOnHost; measured in P3's QA run 2), so 'past readyTTL' is not what this cell exercises.

text: The API session is admitted when its first activity lands (P3, #2107): a ses_… transcript_new. Its first state is not pinned — an API session is first seen working (P4; P5a's smoke cells)
The session binds to the one running 2.x service (pid.go servicePIDFor) — there is no client process
The first prompt drives the session to working
The 2.x plugin's session.execution.succeeded ends turn 1 (recorded as the canonical Stop hook)
Turn 1 ends; the session then idles in ready for at least 15s of the 20s window, with no removal and no process exit on it
invariants: no transcript_removed for the idle session
no process_exited for the idle session

text: After the idle, the next prompt drives the SAME ses_… session ready → working
The 2.x plugin's session.execution.succeeded ends turn 2 (recorded as the canonical Stop hook)
Turn 2 completes back to ready on the same session
